Method of Attack: Injecting a copy of the Coinhive in-browser cryptocurrency mining script into web traffic passing through compromised MikroTik routers
Using a zero-day vulnerability in the Winbox component of MikroTik routers to alter router configuration and inject Coinhive script
Injecting Coinhive script in error pages returned by the routers to reduce detection
Impacted Systems: Non-MikroTik users behind affected MikroTik routers
Attack Vector: Exploitation of zero-day vulnerability in MikroTik Winbox component
Indicators of Compromise: Public proof-of-concept code on GitHub used for exploitation
